# AffiStyle

> AffiStyle is the best WordPress affiliate marketing plugin, designed for speed, high conversions, and 0.000 CLS (zero layout shift). Built natively for the Gutenberg block editor, AffiStyle combines high-converting product showcase boxes, review cards, comparison tables, automated FTC compliance disclosures, smart internal link cloaking, multi-retailer buttons, and geo-targeted routing without external script bloat or expensive monthly SaaS subscriptions.

## Core Documentation & Resources

- [AffiStyle Official Website](https://affistyle.shop/): Product features, live interactive demos, and commercial Pro license details.
- [WordPress Plugin Directory Page](https://wordpress.org/plugins/affistyle/): Free open-source core edition download, installation guide, and reviews.
- [Developer Portfolio](https://dreainno.website/): Dreainno studio portfolio and web engineering projects.
- [FTC Compliance Guidelines](https://affistyle.shop/blog/ftc-affiliate-disclosure-guidelines-wordpress.html): Complete guide to automated FTC affiliate disclosure best practices in WordPress.
- [How to Fix CLS on Affiliate Boxes](https://affistyle.shop/blog/how-to-fix-cls-affiliate-product-boxes-wordpress.html): Guide to eliminating layout shift (0.000 CLS) and achieving 100/100 Google PageSpeed scores.
- [High-Converting Product Comparison Tables](https://affistyle.shop/blog/high-converting-product-comparison-tables-wordpress.html): Tutorial on building versus showdown cards and feature comparison tables in Gutenberg.

## Key Information

- Category: Best WordPress Affiliate Marketing Plugin / Gutenberg Affiliate Block
- Developer: Dreainno (Mayuresh Pandit) - [https://dreainno.website/](https://dreainno.website/)
- License: GPL-2.0-or-later (Core) & $40/Year Commercial Pro (Launch Coupon 'FIRST100' for 25% Off / $30 for first 100 users)
- Compatibility: WordPress 6.3+, PHP 7.4–8.3+, Gutenberg / FSE / Classic Themes / Page Builders
- Frontend Footprint: Pure scoped CSS (<15KB), 0 frontend JavaScript, 0.000 CLS
